description: Source code for the HostResolverProc class implementing DNS host resolution logic, including fallback mechanisms and default procedure management.

classes.name: HostResolverProc
classes.description: Class managing DNS host resolution procedures with fallback and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a host name to an address list, with network handle consideration.

methods.name: ResolveUsingPrevious
methods.description: Uses the previous resolver in the chain to resolve a host, or falls back to system resolver.

methods.name: SetPreviousProc
methods.description: Sets the previous resolver in the chain, ensuring no cycles.

methods.name: SetLastProc
methods.description: Sets the last resolver in the chain.

methods.name: GetLastProc
methods.description: Retrieves the last resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetDefault
methods.description: Sets the default global host resolver.

methods.name: GetDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the current default host resolver.
